Mount Litera Website (Next.js)

Overview
- Next.js site with a Firebase-powered blog system.
- Public blogs page at /blogs and admin CMS at /blogs/admin.

Key directories
- pages/: Next.js pages and API routes.
- components/: shared UI components.
- lib/: Firebase and supporting utilities.
- public/: static assets and page image manifests.
- styles/: Tailwind and global styles.

Local development
- Install: npm install
- Run: npm run dev
- Visit: http://localhost:3000

Environment variables
- Client (NEXT_PUBLIC_*): Firebase web config.
- Server: Firebase Admin SDK credentials.
- See README.md for full variable list.

Notes
- Admin access requires Firebase Auth + Firestore users.role = "admin".
